fact.ability: +2 dice for Body tests to resist pathogens and toxins
+1 natural armor cumulative with worn armor

fact.same_score: simultaneous unless order needed; compare Edge, Initiative, Reaction

fact.free_actions: one free action per initiative pass where character acts

fact.entry: Full Defense and other explicitly allowed interrupt rules

fact.summary: attacker declares attack; defender declares defense method
apply attacker and defender dice pool modifiers
attacker rolls attack skill + attribute; defender rolls defense pool; defender wins ties
use modified damage and armor to decide Physical vs Stun for applicable attacks
defender rolls Body plus applicable armor/resistance modifiers
subtract soak hits and apply remaining boxes to monitor

fact.wound_modifier: -1 per full 3 boxes on any one damage track, cumulative across tracks

fact.physical_overflow: extra physical damage beyond physical track uses overflow rules

fact.stun_overflow: remaining stun after stun track fills converts to physical

fact.impact: used against melee, falling, explosions, etc.

fact.vehicle_armor_rule: if modified DV does not exceed modified vehicle Armor, attack fails

fact.force_attribute: used by spirits, spells, and magical items

fact.magic_loss_from_essence: for each point or fraction below Essence 6, lose 1 Magic/Resonance and reduce maximum by 1

fact.spellcasting_drain_value: spell listed DV plus adjustments such as net hits where applicable

fact.summoning_binding_drain: twice the hits generated by spirit on opposed test

fact.ritual_spellcasting: extended/ritual process with team bonus, time, and seal requirements

fact.counterspelling_spell_defense: add Counterspelling dice to protected defender pools

fact.dispelling: Counterspelling + Magic opposed by spell Force + caster Magic; net hits reduce original spell hits

fact.duration: until sunrise or sunset unless bound

fact.test: Banishing + Magic vs spirit Force or Force + summoner Magic for bound

fact.device_rating_default: all Matrix attributes equal Device rating unless customized

fact.vr_ip: extract exact cold/hot sim initiative passes from Matrix chapter

fact.running_too_many_programs: Response degradation rules need table extraction

fact.hacking_on_the_fly: extract exact Exploit + Hacking vs Firewall model

fact.living_persona: derived from attributes; extract exact mapping

fact.threading_fading: DV equals hits used for rating points; Physical if final rating exceeds Resonance

fact.sprite_fading: DV equals twice sprite hits; Physical if sprite rating exceeds Resonance

fact.attribute_substitution: use Command rating in place of attribute except drone Sensor for Perception

fact.action_cost: Complex Action even when underlying drone task would be Simple

fact.control_rig_bonus: implant bonuses on vehicle/drone tests; exact modifiers extracted from gear/provider

fact.scan_sniffer: needed to locate devices and traffic

fact.vehicle_tests_use: Reaction + vehicle skill +/- Handling; exact cases imported

fact.chase_combat: abstract vehicle-only subsystem; implement after tactical vehicle tests

fact.language_skill_handling: import table and defaults from skills chapter
